Vela CLI  v0.24.0
Register Dataverse plugins and Custom APIs from your build packages.

Usage: vela <command> [options]   (vela <command> --help for its options)

Commands:
  plan      Preview registration changes; never writes to Dataverse.
  apply     Apply the plan (prompts for confirmation on a terminal).
  inspect   Show local and live registrations side by side (read-only).
  init      Scaffold a new solution on disk (minimal by default; --samples for 
worked examples). (alias: new)
  add       Add a plugin, service, Custom API, test or step to a project.
  models    Generate early-bound models, typed messages or roles.
  logs      Read plug-in trace logs or failed system jobs (read-only). (alias: 
trace)
  solution  Print a solution's publisher prefix (read-only).
  sign      Sign a plugin package (managed-identity plugins).
  logout    Clear the cached login token and the remembered URL.
  update    Update the vela global tool.
  menu      Launch the interactive menu (the default with no arguments).
  version   Print the tool version.
  help      Help for one command (vela help <command>), or all as JSON (--json).

Output:
  plan/apply/inspect print a styled summary on a terminal and a versioned JSON document when piped,
  with --json or with --out <file>. Notices and --verbose detail go to stderr. NO_COLOR / VELA_NO_COLOR disable colors.

Exit codes:
  0 success, 2 invalid arguments, 3 file not found, 4 error (incl. --strict), 5 drift (models --verify, apply not converged),
  6 connection failure, 7 partial apply (re-run apply), 8 changes pending (plan --detailed-exitcode only).

vela plan: Preview registration changes; never writes to Dataverse.

Usage:
  vela plan (--package <file.nupkg>... | --packages-dir <folder>) [options] [connection options]

Inputs:
  --package, -p <file.nupkg>                       A built plugin package (repeatable).
  --packages-dir <folder>                          Every .nupkg in a folder (the newest version of each package id).
  --package-assembly <name.dll>                    The primary assembly inside the package(s), when it cannot be inferred.
  --solution, --solution-unique-name <uniquename>  Target solution: writes and components not yet in it are added to it; also resolves the publisher prefix.
  --webresources <folder>                          (preview) Mirror a web resources folder; requires --solution.
  --secure-config <NAME=VALUE|NAME=@file>          Value of a step's named secure configuration (repeatable); or VELA_SECURE_CONFIG_<NAME>.

Output:
  --environment <label>                            Label shown in the output (defaults to --url).
  --out <file>                                     Write the JSON document to a file instead of stdout.
  --json                                           Machine-readable output on stdout (see docs/reference/machine-readable-output.md).
  --verbose, -v                                    More detail on stderr (and full stack traces on failure); never changes stdout.
  --strict                                         Fail (exit 4) when there is any warning in diagnostics. Info notices never fail.
  --detailed-exitcode                              Exit 8 when the plan has changes to apply, 0 when there is nothing to do.

Connection:
  --interactive, -i                                Browser (MSAL) login; the token is cached under ~/.vela so repeat runs are silent.
  --url <https://org.crm.dynamics.com>             Environment URL. Alone, uses your ambient Azure credential (az login / managed identity).
  --tenant-id <id>                                 Tenant for client-secret auth.
  --client-id <appId>    
[truncated]

vela init: Scaffold a new solution on disk (minimal by default; --samples for worked examples).
Aliases: new

Usage:
  vela init --name <SolutionName> [--prefix <Prefix>] [--publisher-prefix <prefix>] [--samples] [options]

Options:
  --name <SolutionName>             Solution name (also accepted as the first positional argument).
  --prefix <Prefix>                 Namespace / assembly prefix of the projects.
  --publisher-prefix <prefix>       Dataverse publisher prefix (2-8 chars) naming the Custom APIs; recorded for 'vela add customapi'.
  --output, -o <dir>                Target folder (default: current directory).
  --samples                         Add the demo code and the Integrations/ConsoleApp projects.
  --minimal, --no-demos             The default: no demo code (kept as an alias).
  --no-integrations                 With --samples: skip the Integrations project.
  --no-tests                        Skip the unit tests project.
  --no-console                      With --samples: skip the console project.
  --core-version <ver>              Vela.Plugins version (default: latest on nuget.org).
  --managed-identity, --mi          With --samples: add the signing step to the Integrations package.
  --web-resources, --webresources   (preview) Add a TypeScript web resources project.
  --web-resources-namespace <name>  (preview) Namespace of the web resources.
  --web-resources-folder <dir>      (preview) Folder of the web resources.
  --force                           Regenerate into a non-empty folder; only files Vela wrote and you did not edit are overwritten or removed.
  --interactive, -i                 Guided prompts.
  --json                            Machine-readable output on stdout (see docs/reference/machine-readable-output.md).
  --verbose, -v                     More detail on stderr (and full stack traces on failure); never changes stdout.
  --help, -h                        Show this help.

Examples:
  vela init --name ZavaSales --prefix Zava --publisher-prefix zava --output .
  vela init --n
[truncated]

vela models: Generate early-bound models, typed messages or roles.

Usage:
  vela models <scope>... [options] [connection options]
  vela models --from-solution <solution.zip> --namespace <ns>   (offline)

Scopes (combinable):
  --solution <uniquename>               Tables taken from the solution's components.
  --entities <a,b,c>                    Table logical names.
  --custom-apis [a,b,c]                 Custom API unique names (bare: every Custom API, with a warning).
  --messages [a,b,c]                    SDK request names, e.g. SendEmail (bare: one class per request of every consumable message).
  --roles <a,b,c>                       Security role names: a dependency-light Roles class.
  --solution-roles                      Every security role in --solution.
  --intersect                           Also the N:N intersect tables of the scoped tables.
  --from-solution <zip>                 Offline: entity models and option sets from an exported solution zip.
  --forms                               (preview) TypeScript FormModel files.
  --tables                              (preview) TypeScript Web API record interfaces.

Packages:
  --package, -p <file.nupkg>            Built plugin package(s): with a bare --custom-apis, excludes the Custom APIs you authored (repeatable).
  --packages-dir <folder>               A folder of .nupkg packages, used like --package.
  --package-assembly <name.dll>         The primary assembly inside the package(s).

Output:
  --lang <lang>                         csharp (default) | ts.
  --namespace <ns>                      Output namespace (default: inferred from the project).
  --project <csproj>                    Project whose namespace and Models/Generated folder are used.
  --out <dir>                           Output directory (default: current directory).
  --no-annotations                      Omit DataAnnotations ([StringLength]/[Range]).
  --overwrite                           Overwrite existing files.
  --verify                              Do not write: report d

Aliases: trace

Usage:
  vela logs [options] [connection options]

Options:
  --jobs                                Failed system jobs (asyncoperation) instead of the trace log.
  --all-statuses                        With --jobs: every status, not only failed.
  --errors                              Trace log entries with an exception only.
  --top <n>                             Max entries, newest first (1-200, default 20).
  --since <when>                        A duration (30m, 2h, 3d) or a date.
  --type <name>                         Plugin type name (substring).
  --message <m>                         SDK message.
  --entity <logical>                    Table logical name.
  --correlation <guid>                  Correlation id.
  --full                                Do not truncate trace and exception text.
  --json                                Machine-readable output on stdout (see docs/reference/machine-readable-output.md).
  --verbose, -v                         More detail on stderr (and full stack traces on failure); never changes stdout.

Vela CLI  v0.24.0
Register Dataverse plugins and Custom APIs from your build packages.

Usage: vela <command> [options]   (vela <command> --help for its options)

Commands:
  plan      Preview registration changes; never writes to Dataverse.
  apply     Apply the plan (prompts for confirmation on a terminal).
  inspect   Show local and live registrations side by side (read-only).
  init      Scaffold a new solution on disk (minimal by default; --samples for 
worked examples). (alias: new)
  add       Add a plugin, service, Custom API, test or step to a project.
  models    Generate early-bound models, typed messages or roles.
  logs      Read plug-in trace logs or failed system jobs (read-only). (alias: 
trace)
  solution  Print a solution's publisher prefix (read-only).
  sign      Sign a plugin package (managed-identity plugins).
  logout    Clear the cached login token and the remembered URL.
  update    Update the vela global tool.
  menu      Launch the interactive menu (the default with no arguments).
  version   Print the tool version.
  help      Help for one command (vela help <command>), or all as JSON (--json).

Output:
  plan/apply/inspect print a styled summary on a terminal and a versioned JSON document when piped,
  with --json or with --out <file>. Notices and --verbose detail go to stderr. NO_COLOR / VELA_NO_COLOR disable colors.

Exit codes:
  0 success, 2 invalid arguments, 3 file not found, 4 error (incl. --strict), 5 drift (models --verify, apply not converged),
  6 connection failure, 7 partial apply (re-run apply), 8 changes pending (plan --detailed-exitcode only).
